VBO:0200467.summary: Cheerful and affectionate, the Dutch Smoushond often brings a lively, gentle presence to its people. It tends to enjoy learning and responds best to consistent, gentle handling. Once a carriage follower and stable rat-catcher in the Netherlands, the modern breed was rebuilt from similar-looking dogs after a revival began in 1973.
VBO:0200467.shortDescription: A cheerful, affectionate Dutch companion, keen to learn with gentle guidance and roots in stable rat-catching.

sources.title: Dutch Smoushond: FCI Standard 308
sources.evidence: Behavior/Temperament describes affectionate, cheerful, friendly and free-spirited character with lively but not nervous disposition. History states following horses/carriages and catching stable rats in nineteenth-century Netherlands; last1949 litter and1973 reconstruction with lookalike crossbreeds. All adult anatomical sections read: square sturdy body; broad shortish head, small drooping ears; coarse straight4–7cm straw-yellow coat; rather short natural bushy tail not curled over back.

sources.title: Hollandse Smoushonden Club: Character
sources.evidence: Actual character paragraph describes cheerful/free character, affection and gentle nature, desire to learn/listen, consistent gentle handling; anger often counterproductive. Child suitability and absolute hereditary-health claims excluded.
